sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,

Your offer is far below any calculation we can make. Please explain its basis.

The requested Lieferzeit is not feasible; we quote our earliest. A shorter Lieferzeit means overtime; that is priced in. Faster payment helps our cash flow; that is reflected in the price. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. A different delivery term moves the freight between us; that is priced in.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

We stand by our offer of a price of €18.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. It remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
